title: Early-Failure Credit on Recalled Work — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** On the acceptance of a company-elected cash offer under a Homeowner Service Contract, the early-failure credit applies when the request is a recall of earlier Bridgewell work and is counted from that earlier work's completion date to the recall's request date:

- when the recall came **no more than 30 days** after the completion, the credit is the amount recorded on the earlier work's authorization multiplied by 0.25 and rounded to the cent, returning the installation share of work that failed at once;
- when it came **later but within the guarantee window** of the earlier work (the replacement labor guarantee for a Bridgewell-provided replacement, the repair guarantee for a repair), the credit is **100.00**;
- when the request is not a recall or the recall came after that window, there is **no credit**.

Accepting the cash closes the claim, so this credit, which Bridgewell owes on the request, is settled in the same payment: it is added to the accepted offer amount as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, before the total is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits.

**Guarantee windows by tier (calendar days after completion).**

| Tier | Earlier Bridgewell replacement | Earlier Bridgewell repair |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell ApplianceCare | 365 | 30 |
| Bridgewell SystemsCare | 365 | 30 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze | 365 | 30 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Silver | 365 | 30 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | 365 | 60 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | 365 | 90 |

**Cases (hypothetical).**

| Earlier work | Days from completion to the recall's request date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| replacement authorized at 2,180.00 | 12 | 2,180.00 times 0.25: 545.00 |
| replacement, any amount | 200 | 100.00 |
| repair on Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | 45 | 100.00 |
| repair on Bridgewell HomeCare Silver | 45 | none (after the 30-day window) |
| repair authorized at 410.00, any tier | 30 | 102.50 |
| not a recall | — | none |
